public_body: Bridgewater State University Student Governmnet Association
overall: The AG found neither the Bridgewater State University Student Government Association nor its Senate is a public body under the Open Meeting Law because they serve only the campus community, so no violation and no notice violation occurred.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Association failed to properly post notice of its October 15 meeting as required by Section 20(b).
allegations.key_passage: Because we find that the Association and the Association Senate are not public bodies, we also find that they did not violate the Open Meeting Law by not posting notice of the October 15 meeting.

allegations.summary: In the alternative, complaint alleged the Association Senate violated the Open Meeting Law in connection with its October 15 meeting.
allegations.key_passage: Based on the above, neither the Association nor the Senate serves a “public purpose,” as that term is used in our Open Meeting Law analysis.
